# Contributor handoff

## Task and state

Issue/milestone, branch, commit, and whether work is committed or still local.

## Completed

Observable behavior implemented and relevant files.

## Verification

Exact commands and actual outcomes. Identify checks not run and why.

## Decisions

Link canonical ADRs or contracts. Identify unresolved assumptions.

## Remaining work

Specific next actions, dependencies, and known failures. Never include credentials or private records.
